checks.name: A1 the Clifford rank of a cell is 2k+1 (s = 2,4,8 -> 3,5,7), verified constructively AND for maximality
A2 ... so on the NAIVE reading the model's s = 36 quark cell would permit d <= 11 and F291 S1 would be gone
B1 one Weyl branch: the hop's traceless span is 3 and its anticommuting rank is 3 (F291 S1 reproduced)
B2 the model's BRANCH-DOUBLED cell widens the span to 6 but the anticommuting rank is STILL 3 -- tau_3 x sigma_i commutes with 1 x sigma_i
B3 an internal factor (x)1_3 changes NOTHING: span 6, anticommuting rank 3, on a cell of dimension 12
B4 CONVERSE: a walk that genuinely USES 5 anticommuting generators on C^4 has ker J = coker J = 0 at d = 5, so the selector returns 5 -- enlargements are not all alike
C1 the commutant over generic momenta FACTORISES: 2 at N=1 becomes 18 at N=3 -- exactly a factor N^2 = 9
C2 ... and every added element is NON-DISPERSIVE (0.0) while the update disperses -- a symmetry, not a clock, so F313's d_time = 1 survives the internal factor
D1 the 3-constituent totally antisymmetric state on one nodeless level EXISTS at N = 3
D2 ... and N = 1 is EXCLUDED for 3 constituents: spin alone caps the occupancy of a nodeless level at TWO
D3 the honest negative: every space/time verdict is IDENTICAL at N=1 and N=3 while the commutant is not -- the CELL does not force the index, it only shapes it

summary.PERMIT: free.  The internal factor costs ZERO spatial directions (the hop's anticommuting rank stays 3) and ZERO time directions (every added commutant element is non-dispersive).
summary.SHAPE: forced.  An enlargement that adds an anticommuting generator to the hop moves the F291 selector from 3 to 2k+1; neither of the model's two enlargements (branch doubling, internal tensoring) does.
summary.FORCE: NOT by the cell.  The cell is indifferent.  The forcing is Fermi statistics: spin alone caps a nodeless level at two identical constituents, so the model's three-constituent bound state is impossible at N = 1.
summary.F291_conditionality_removed: F291 §3 flags 'conditional on s = 2 ... a larger cell would relax this to d <= 2k+1'.  Measured here: the model's own s = 36 quark cell does NOT relax it, because the bound that matters is the anticommuting rank of the HOP's span, not the Clifford rank of the cell.
summary.F313_criterion_added: F313's d_time = 1 needs one criterion it does not state, once the cell has an internal factor: a commuting unitary is a clock only if it DISPERSES.  F313 §9's second flow was dispersive (hence F315); the colour elements are not, at literal 0.0.
summary.residual_input: moved, not closed: from 'an internal index exists' to 'the matter sector contains a THREE-constituent bound state'.  The number three is still not derived here.
